checkpoint.scope: Candidate PostgreSQL database only; cluster roles, other databases, volumes, and external media excluded

restore_rehearsal.network: internal with no published host ports
restore_rehearsal.target: fresh isolated PostgreSQL volume and template0 database
restore_rehearsal.initial_attempt: A separate disposable restore rolled back because the bootstrap omitted kokonut_weather_observation_owner; the candidate was untouched. The role prerequisite SQL was expanded and covered by focused regression tests before a fresh restore attempt passed.

rollback: The pre-migration encrypted checkpoint remains available locally. The previous app image is retained under the recorded rollback tag. If database rollback is required, restore the checkpoint to a separate database and validate it before any deliberate candidate database replacement; no destructive automatic downgrade was run.
acceptance_limit: This closes local candidate schema rollout and restore rehearsal only. It does not accept EAS provider parity, live worker credentials, persisted task reconciliation, offset pagination, earlier-arrival recovery, or MAN-CAP-040/047.
